questions.question: Who is a Scrum master?
questions.solution_html:
• A Scrum Master is the facilitator or the leader of the Scrum team who ensures that Scrum principles and
  • practices are followed. They remove obstacles, guide the team, and promote collaboration for smooth
  • project progress.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: What is a risk exposure?
questions.solution_html:
• Risk exposure - is the overall consequence of a risk.
  • It is the potential loss or impact a project may face if a risk occurs. It is calculated as
  • RE = PXC, Where P is the probability of occurrence of a risk and C is the cost to the project should the
  • risk occur.
  • Risk Exposure = Probability × Impact.
  • Consider any one explanation (1 mark) and one formula (1 mark) .
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: Consider any one explanation and one formula .

questions.question: What do you mean by the design concept "modularization"?
questions.solution_html:
• Modularization is a design concept in which a software system is divided into separate, independent
  • modules, each performing a specific function, to improve maintainability, re-usability, and
  • understandability.
